clauses.clause: Same city as L4 (pair cameras read "same place, fallen"); sun intensity falls ≥ 30 % to the metro.
clauses.note: Eight exact matched L4/L5 camera pairs (4 authored city anchors×2 tiers) personally reviewed: camera position and target identical per pair. Same plaza/Harbor storefront/metro/Kessler fence corner, with actual aftermath damage, wrecks, ash and fog. Native current complete sun multiplier0.5 at metro/end both tiers, a50% fall (required≥30%); actual initial renderer L4 intensity1.3 versus L5.816 is separately recorded. Sixteen original frames retained for PO same-place-fallen taste, with SHA and concrete comparison; taste is not answered for PO. Explicit controlled photo anchors/objective setup, no route benchmark claim.
